senses.LEGAL: material admitted, admissible, or relied upon under a legal evidentiary context; not synonymous with scientific evidence
senses.MEDICAL: research or clinical support whose authority depends on claim type and clinical context

senses.FORMAL: a derivation meeting a specified formal system or proof standard
senses.SCIENCE: avoid as a synonym for empirical confirmation; use evidence/support

senses.MEDICAL: clinical significance is separate from statistical significance
senses.EVERYDAY: importance or consequence in ordinary language

senses.SCIENCE: causal claim under a stated empirical or formal identification framework

senses.LEGAL: legal causation applies jurisdiction-specific legal tests

senses.MEDICAL: clinical classification requiring an appropriate clinical context and authority
senses.COMPUTING: problem identification in a software or hardware system

senses.SCIENCE: a scientific explanatory framework; strength depends on field and evidence
senses.FORMAL: a set of axioms, definitions, or formal structures

senses.SCIENCE: a representation used for explanation, simulation, or prediction
senses.FORMAL: an interpretation satisfying a formal theory
senses.COMPUTING: may mean a software/data model or machine-learning model

senses.SCIENCE: an experiment, assay, or statistical procedure

senses.MEDICAL: health outcome probability or clinical risk under a stated population/context
senses.SECURITY: threat likelihood/consequence under a stated threat model
senses.ENGINEERING: hazard likelihood/consequence under a stated safety framework
senses.ECONOMICS: uncertainty or exposure under an economic/financial model

senses.MEDICAL: reference-range or clinical usage requiring population/context
senses.FORMAL: a technical property whose meaning depends on the formal subfield
senses.EVERYDAY: ordinary or typical; not a clinical classification

senses.LEGAL: a legal responsibility determined under applicable law
senses.BUSINESS: an accounting obligation when used in accounting context
senses.EVERYDAY: a disadvantage or burden; not a legal conclusion

senses.FORMAL: truth under all interpretations or validity under a formal system, depending on subfield

senses.LEGAL: legal validity depends on applicable law and authority
senses.EDUCATION: evidence supporting interpretation/use of assessment results

rules: definitions do not transfer across modes without an explicit bridge
terminology resolution does not provide evidence for the underlying claim
